basic_details.short_information: Bharatiya Nabhikiya Vidyut Nigam Limited (BHAVINI), a Government of India Enterprise at Kalpakkam, is engaging 12 Advisor / Consultants. There are 4 posts at Engineer level (Scientific Officer/F level or equivalent, Level 13) and 8 posts at Foreman/Senior Technician level (Level 8). These posts are only for employees of BHAVINI/NPCIL/DAE and its Constituent Units who have retired or are due to retire by the last date of receipt of application. content_sections.heading: BHAVINI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Annexure-B of the notice lists the scope of work for each discipline as follows. Monitoring and control of vital parameters in TG, Steam and water system, and auxiliaries. Ensuring plant parameters within the specified normal range values. Start-up and shutdown of various pumps, blowers and electrical equipment such as Condensate Extraction pumps, Boiler feed pumps, OGDHR pumps and Fans, etc. Start-up of steam water system, feed water heating, TG warm up and rolling, synchronization to GRID and sustained operation of TG set. Assisting and guiding commissioning team during commissioning, testing and integrated operation. Round the clock operation. Monitoring of various plant parameters and operation of equipment in TG, Steam and water system, and auxiliaries. Recording plant parameters within the specified normal range values. Field operation for start-up and shutdown of various pumps, blowers and electrical equipment such as Condensate Extraction pumps, Boiler feed pumps, OGDHR pumps and Fans, etc. Field operations for start-up of steam water system, feed water heating, TG warm up and rolling, synchronization to GRID and sustained operation of TG set. Assisting commissioning team during commissioning, testing and integrated operation. Reviewing the maintenance procedures for TG and auxiliary systems. Coordinate turbine rolling, barring gear operation and trial runs. Maintenance of governing valves, control valves and stop valves, and of the EHC (Electro-Hydraulic Control) system. Check functioning of turbine trip and emergency protection systems. Maintenance of lube oil, control oil and jacking oil systems; condensate extraction pumps (CEP); boiler feed pumps (BFP) and their driving turbines/motors, as applicable; cooling water pumps and seal water pumps. Maintenance of gland steam condenser and gland sealing system; vacuum pumps and air ejectors; heat exchangers, oil coolers and filters; circulating water and auxiliary cooling systems; HP and LP bypass valves. Conduct inspection of pumps, motors, gearboxes and rotating equipment. Checking mechanical seals, gland packing, bearings and couplings. Perform shaft alignment using dial gauges and laser alignment equipment. Inspect piping, valves, flanges and expansion joints; carry out hydraulic testing and pressure testing wherever required. Identify oil leakage, water leakage and steam leakage; monitor equipment health through vibration and temperature analysis. Check rotor run-out, eccentricity, shaft alignment and bearing clearances; inspect and maintain journal bearings and thrust bearings; check bearing metal temperature, vibration and oil parameters. Monitor differential expansion, axial displacement and rotor eccentricity; inspect gland sealing and labyrinth sealing arrangements. Supervise dismantling, cleaning, and inspection of internal components. Checking and servicing of motor, gearbox, bearings, and seals. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BHAVINI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 Advisor / Consultant posts. Four are at Engineer level (one each in Operations, Mechanical, Electrical and Instrumentation Maintenance) and eight are at Foreman/Senior Technician level (two in each of these disciplines).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BHAVINI Advisor / Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be received within seven days from the date of issue of the advertisement dated 21 November 2026, which is about 28 November 2026. Incomplete and late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for BHAVINI Advertisement No. 3/2026/HR?
faq.answer: Only employees of BHAVINI/NPCIL/DAE and its Constituent Units who have retired or are due to retire by the last date of receipt of application can apply. They must have held Scientific Officer/F level or equivalent (Level 13) for the Engineer posts, or Foreman/Senior Technician or equivalent (Level 8) for the Foreman posts.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is needed for these posts?
faq.answer: Applicants should have worked as an engineer or a Foreman/Senior operator or technician in the relevant discipline in 220MWe and above nuclear power plants, in TG and auxiliary systems.

faq.question: Q5. How is the pay of a retired employee fixed for the BHAVINI consultant post?
faq.answer: The pay is a fixed monthly amount: the last pay drawn (only basic) at retirement minus the basic pension. It remains unchanged for the term of contract.

faq.question: Q6. Do DA, HRA or increments come with the BHAVINI consultant pay?
faq.answer: No. Increment, Dearness Allowance and HRA are not admissible during re-engagement. A to and fro transport facility between Anupuram and the place of work is provided, and paid leave may be allowed at 2 days per completed month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for BHAVINI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-A form, affix a passport size photograph and enclose a copy of the Pension Payment Order. Send it by post in a sealed envelope to the Deputy General Manager (HR) – Rect. Section, BHAVINI, Kalpakkam, Chengalpattu DT, TN – 603102.

faq.question: Q8. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write "APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT OF CONSULTANT / ADVISOR (ENGINEER & FOREMAN/SENIOR TECHNICIAN) IN BHAVINI" on the envelope.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The Selection Committee will scrutinize the applications and may interact with candidates if required. Engagement depends on vigilance clearance/vigilance inputs covering the 10 years before retirement.

faq.question: Q10. Is the BHAVINI consultant engagement permanent, and for how long?
faq.answer: No, it is purely temporary and can be terminated at any time. The initial term ordinarily does not exceed six months and is extendable by another six months. Further extension may be granted, but not beyond five years after superannuation.
